description: Creates the payment request for the invoice (QR bill, TWINT, card). The flow reaches PAYMENT only on the signed event of the payment provider. Needs state INVOICE. Never: Mark anything paid or pay out without a settled status. Platform fee CHF 0.10 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

flow_id.description: The flow (job) id, which is also its chain id.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every mutate and money call; a retry with the same key returns the same result and is not charged again.

quote_id.description: A valid quote for this capability (quote).

name: payment_collect
title: Request payment
